votes.motion: Approve the formal meeting minutes of Tuesday, November 10, 2020; Tuesday, November 17, 2020; and Tuesday, December 1, 2020.
votes.description: The Council approved the official minutes from three prior formal meetings. This is a routine administrative action to adopt the record of previous meetings.

votes.motion: Continue the public hearing on Budget Amendment No. 6 for Fiscal Year 2020-21 until January 19, 2021.
votes.description: The Council voted to continue the public hearing on the FY2020-21 Budget Amendment No. 6 to a later date, allowing additional public comment. The amendment covers items such as funding for the Fisher Mansion Carriage House, Glendale Waterpark redevelopment, and a new City Innovations Team.

votes.motion: Approve the ratification of Councilmember Fowler to serve as Council Chair, and Councilmember Rogers to serve as Vice Chair for calendar year 2021.
votes.description: The Council ratified the election of Amy Fowler as Council Chair and James Rogers as Vice Chair for the 2021 calendar year. This is a standard organizational action taken at the start of each year.

votes.motion: Approve the ratification of the determination for the Council to continue meeting remotely and without an anchor location under HB5002.
votes.description: The Council ratified the ongoing determination to hold meetings electronically without a physical anchor location, as permitted under HB5002 during the declared emergency. This continues a practice in place since July 2020.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 2 of 2021 entering into Amendment Number 1 to Addendum Number 2, and Addendum Number 3 to the Interlocal Agreement with the Utah Transit Authority, and place the remaining $979,545.19 into a holding account reserved for future Funding Our Future transit expenses.
votes.description: The Council adopted a resolution authorizing the Mayor to execute amendments to the City's interlocal agreement with UTA, including accounting adjustments for COVID-19-related service reductions and a new service agreement for Frequent Transit Network routes. Remaining funds are reserved for future transit expenses.

votes.motion: Adopt the Consent agenda, including the reappointment of Jessica Andrew to the Police Civilian Review Board for a term ending November 21, 2021.
votes.description: The Council approved the consent agenda, which included reappointing Jessica Andrew to the Police Civilian Review Board to fill the District One seat vacated by a term-limited member.
